selection.rule: Ascending sha256(prefix + '|' + family + '|' + canonical_id), then canonical_id

filed_flat.scope: One common leaf; neutral wrappers satisfy two-level filing.

lexical.cluster_count_rule: The two fixed distance cuts of one complete average-linkage dendrogram; eligible cluster counts are 1 through n. No reference or output-score selection.
lexical.tie_rule: Input rows sorted by opaque record ID; pinned SciPy linkage and fcluster implementation.
lexical.empty_vocabulary: All zero vectors; off-diagonal distance 1 and diagonal distance 0.
lexical.zero_vector: Cosine similarity to another vector is zero, including another zero vector; diagonal distance is zero.
lexical.one_record: One top folder and one leaf folder.
lexical.identical_nonzero_vectors: Zero distance; one shared leaf if all vectors coincide.

random_shape.rule: Uniform seeded permutation of sorted record IDs into the lexical assignment slots, preserving all lexical leaf sizes and nesting.

reporting.random_aggregation: Mean seeds within each task, then equal-weight task means within family.
reporting.failed_predictions: Retain explicit failure; never silently omit or change denominators.
reporting.uncertainty: Descriptive exposed development pilot; no independent-packet inference.

live.admission: Independent parent approval of exact protocol/jobs and actual holds/routes required before any live call.
